problem: When a claim line is denied with CARC CO-4, the procedure code is inconsistent with the modifier used, or a required modifier is missing. Today nothing stops an unchanged line from being resubmitted, and nothing prevents a tool from guessing a modifier. Northwind's denial workbench must let the coder set the corrected modifier and the biller resubmit it. Resubmission must stay blocked until the modifier has changed, and the product must never suggest, prefill, or invent a modifier value. The denial specialist works this queue every day and needs to recognize CO-4 rows at a glance as coder-then-biller work, not appeal work.
users: Coder: sole role that sets or changes the modifier on a CO-4 line (Q-1, pack/roles.md)
Biller: sole role that resubmits a corrected CO-4 line (Q-1, pack/roles.md)
Denial specialist: triages the denial workqueue daily; sees CO-4 rows but does not edit modifiers, resubmit, or appeal them
PFS lead: sees counts by CARC class only
inScope: Display of the exact CO-4 next action and fixture remark N519 on CO-4 lines
A modifier entry field for the coder with no suggestion, prefill, autocomplete, or ranked list
Role gating: only the coder edits the modifier and only the biller resubmits
A resubmission block until the modifier differs from the modifier on the denied line
The claim state transition from denied to submitted on a valid resubmission
Workqueue presentation of CO-4 rows for the denial specialist: CARC class filter, sort by days remaining, deadline risk visible without opening the row
Excluding CO-4 lines from appeal and appeal-ready
Synthetic-only fixtures (PAT-###, CLM-###, DOC-###) subject to the demo PHI scanner
outOfScope: Suggesting, recommending, inferring, or generating any modifier, CPT, or ICD value
Diagnosis code changes and balance write-offs by any role
Handling of CO-16, CO-197, PR-1, and OA-23 beyond their existing workqueue grouping
HIPAA determinations or a business associate agreement

assumptions.text: The coder sets the corrected modifier; the biller resubmits the claim.
The product never suggests a modifier.
A CO-4 line cannot be resubmitted unchanged; the modifier must change first.

requirements.statement: Every CO-4 line shows its CARC code, its fixture remark, and the next action copied exactly from the CARC table: "Correct the modifier and resubmit. Do not invent a modifier in this product."
requirements.rationale: The CARC table is the only source of next actions, and the product must not invent meanings (pack/carc-demo.md).

requirements.statement: The product never suggests, prefills, autocompletes, ranks, defaults, or generates a modifier value on a CO-4 line. The only modifier values the product shows are the value on the denied line and a value the coder typed.
requirements.rationale: The brief, Q-2, and the CO-4 next action all forbid inventing a modifier, and the product does not suggest CPT or ICD changes (pack/roles.md).

requirements.statement: Only the coder can edit the modifier on a CO-4 line. For every other role, the modifier is read-only.
requirements.rationale: Q-1 assigns this to the coder, and the coder owns modifiers (pack/roles.md).

requirements.statement: A CO-4 line cannot be resubmitted while its current modifier equals the modifier on the denied line.
requirements.rationale: Q-3 requires the modifier to change before resubmission.

requirements.statement: Only the biller can resubmit a CO-4 line. A valid resubmission moves the line from denied to submitted.
requirements.rationale: Q-1 and pack/roles.md assign resubmission to the biller, and the transition uses only the states in pack/claim-states.md.

requirements.statement: The denial workqueue shows CO-4 rows that can be filtered by CARC class and sorted by days remaining to the filing deadline. Deadline risk is visible without opening the row. Patient-responsibility lines appear in a separate group.
requirements.rationale: The denial specialist's daily triage follows the workqueue pattern (pack/patterns/workqueue.md).

requirements.statement: A CO-4 line can never be appealed or moved to appeal-ready.
requirements.rationale: Appeal-ready is allowed only for a CO-50 line after the readiness gate passes (pack/claim-states.md). CO-4's next action is correct and resubmit.

requirements.statement: No role can write off a balance or change a diagnosis code from a CO-4 line.
requirements.rationale: Nobody in this demo may write off a balance or change a diagnosis code (pack/roles.md).

requirements.statement: CO-4 fixtures and seed data use only PAT-###, CLM-###, and DOC-### identifiers and pass the demo PHI scanner before a run proceeds.
requirements.rationale: pack/phi-policy.md requires synthetic identifiers and blocks a run when the scanner finds a hit.

screens.title: Denial workqueue
screens.purpose: The denial specialist's daily triage table. It filters by CARC class, sorts by days remaining, shows deadline risk on each row, keeps patient responsibility in a separate group, and marks CO-4 rows as coder-then-biller work.

screens.title: CO-4 line detail and modifier correction
screens.purpose: Shows the CO-4 code, remark N519, the exact next action, and the denied modifier. Gives the coder a blank, suggestion-free modifier field and shows it read-only to every other role. Offers no appeal, write-off, or diagnosis controls.

screens.title: Resubmit review
screens.purpose: Shows the biller the denied and current modifier side by side and enables resubmission only when they differ. A valid resubmission moves the line from denied to submitted.

openQuestions.text: Open: The brief says the biller corrects the modifier, but Q-1 and pack/roles.md say the coder sets it. Confirm that Q-1 supersedes the brief wording.
Proposed: Removing a modifier, or adding one where none existed, counts as a change for the resubmission block. Needs sign-off.
Proposed: The line stays in denied after the coder saves a modifier and moves to submitted only when the biller resubmits; no new claim state is added. Needs sign-off.
Proposed: CO-4 rows appear in the workqueue's denial table alongside appealable denials and are labelled as correct-and-resubmit work, not appeal work. Needs sign-off.
Open: How does a CO-4 line reach the coder from the workqueue: an explicit route action by the denial specialist or biller, or a shared coder queue?
Proposed: Record who changed the modifier, the prior and new values, the time, and who resubmitted. Needs sign-off.
Open: When a claim has several CO-4 lines, must every CO-4 line have a changed modifier before the biller can resubmit the claim?
Open: How should a CO-4 line display when it arrives with a remark other than N519, or with no remark?
Open: What happens when a resubmitted line is denied again with CO-4? Should the comparison baseline become the most recently denied modifier?

carcReferences.nextAction: Correct the modifier and resubmit. Do not invent a modifier in this product.
Appeal with the coverage policy and a clinical-note reference. Do not change the diagnosis code in this product.
Post the amount to patient responsibility. Do not open an appeal.
